newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's end-Oct palm oil stocks 953,241 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's end-Oct palm oil stocks 953,241 tonnes.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil stocks rose 6.57 percent to 953,241 tonnes at end-October from 894,438 at end-September and compared with 706,017 tonnes at end-October 1995, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Friday.

Stocks of crude palm oil were 601,166 tonnes, against 524,322 at end-September and 368,087 a year earlier. Processed palm oil stocks totalled 352,075 tonnes compared with 370,116 and 339,930 respectively, PORLA said.

Stocks of crude palm kernel oil were 70,804 tonnes at end-October against 65,601 at end-September and 48,335 at end-October 1995. Processed palm kernel oil stocks were 55,818 tonnes compared with 53,309 and 35,517 respectively.
